verdict.rationale: Flagsmith exposes a full Admin API, CLI, and MCP server that can programmatically create/update/delete flags, segments, and environments, which could be scripted to perform many operations in sequence, but no evidence describes a dedicated bulk/batch endpoint or UI for acting on many items simultaneously. missing for 10: explicit bulk-create/update/delete API or CLI command, evidence of batch operations across many flags/segments/environments in a single call, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk usage patterns.
